0: Quality improvement initiative (change in preoperative protocol for cesarean delivery)
Time from regional anesthesia placement to infant delivery during cesarean delivery

cohort.0: 194 patients who underwent scheduled or nonemergency cesarean delivery between May 1 and July 15, 2018.

finding.0: A quality improvement initiative, involving performing preoperative preparation activities prior to operating room arrival, significantly reduced the time from regional anesthesia placement to infant delivery during cesarean delivery.
